# Sprites — how far from vanilla

**Generated by `python3 tools/gbaspritecensus.py --write`; do not edit by hand.** *Measured against pret's `upstream/master` by pixel, at engine commit `dce49b31a`.* **Redrawn** means the drawing differs; **recoloured** is the same drawing with another palette in the PNG; **added** sprites vanilla never had and are kept out of the percentage. *The people line is the headline: every overworld figure and trainer picture a player sees, which is what 9.4's fable rule asks for.*

| sprites | vanilla shipped | redrawn | recoloured | still vanilla | added | done |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| overworld people | 87 | 85 | 0 | 2 | 56 | **98%** |
| trainer portraits | 146 | 65 | 0 | 81 | 9 | **45%** |
| trainer back pics | 6 | 4 | 0 | 2 | 0 | **67%** |
| intro portraits | 4 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **100%** |
| hearsay portraits | 6 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **100%** |
| daemon fronts | 386 | 227 | 0 | 159 | 1 | **59%** |
| daemon backs | 384 | 226 | 0 | 158 | 1 | **59%** |
| daemon icons | 387 | 226 | 0 | 161 | 1 | **58%** |
| overworld daemons | 42 | 36 | 0 | 6 | 0 | **86%** |
| overworld objects | 19 | 19 | 0 | 0 | 1 | **100%** |
| ***the people*** | 249 | 164 | 0 | 85 | 65 | ***65.9%*** |
| ***every sprite*** | 1467 | 898 | 0 | 569 | 69 | ***61.2%*** |

## The towns

**A town's people are the sheets its maps put on screen, BENCHMARK interiors aside.** *A sheet shared with other towns can carry only one look, so a town themed to its own colour needs its own sprites where it shares* (vision.md 3.1).

| town | colour and theme | people sheets on screen | still vanilla | shared with other towns | done |
